newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT-Vickers says subscribe to Popular.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Vickers says subscribe to Popular.

text.p: Vickers Ballas Investment Research recommended on Tuesday that investors subscribe to an initial public offer by bilingual bookstore Popular Holdings Ltd, at Singapore $0.36.
The bookstore is offering 75 million new shares comprising 63.75 million public shares and 11.25 million placement shares. The offer closes on May 7.
"The emphasis on bilingual education and rising educational stadards will drive sales," Vickers said in a report.
"Demand for education-related books has been on a stable uptrend as it is an inelastic product," it said.

Vickers said Popular's earnings were likely to grow 20 percent compounded through to year 2000, sustained by publishing operations, an increase in retail sales throught outlet expansion and provision of office stationery.
Popular is planning to open at least three franchised bookstores in Singapore annually over the next five years and is targetting a bookstore in each Malaysian state by 2000.
